doc.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022

title: Her musical heroes
summary: A short list of heroes from Rollins and Coltrane to Ingrid Jensen and George Garzone.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: I’ve enjoyed this a lot. What’s a short list of your musical heroes?

Well I mean Sonny Rollins, Coltrane, Dexter Gordon, Joe Henderson, Lester Young, Kenny Garrett, Cannonball, Bird, and then Ingrid Jensen, Roberta Pickett, Victor Jones. I mean I get to play with all these people and they’re such great musicians and they
continue to grow and I just I think they’re inspiring you know and the music moves on. Coltrane’s been dead how many decades? You know George Garzone, I love George Garzone. Do you know him?

Yeah, yeah. And saxophone players, and it just — I mean I have my people that I grew up loving and at this point I mean I still love them of course but I just really love, of the people today that are creative within what I determine in my little world of jazz that I like.
